featured.title: MiMinions
featured.label: Current work
featured.description: Building an individual AI agent is one thing. Getting several agents to coordinate their work is a different problem.
featured.focus: That’s the idea behind MiMinions: a platform for autonomous organizations, where AI agents can divide work, coordinate, and bring their results together.
featured.available: The public Python framework includes configurable agents, a command-line interface, and local workspaces.
